lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:
You have been blessed with this human body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d milan kee ih teree bareeaa ||
lines.translation: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
lines.translation: Other efforts are of no use to you.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Make the effort, and cross over the terrifying world ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam brithaa jaat ra(n)g maaiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This human life is passing away in vain, in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have not practiced meditation, penance, self-restraint or righteous living;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have not served the Holy Saints, and I do not know the Lord, my King.
Says Nanak, my actions are vile and despicable;
O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary - please, preserve my honor. ||2||29||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar naahee mai doojaa too(n) mere man maahee ||
lines.translation: Without You, there is no other for me; You alone are in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) saajan sa(n)gee prabh meraa kaahe jee daraahee ||1||
lines.translation: You are my Friend and Companion, God; why should my soul be afraid? ||1||
You are my support, You are my hope.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baithat oothat sovat jaagat visar naahee too(n) saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: While sitting down or standing up, while sleeping or waking, with every breath and morsel of food, I never forget You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh raakh saran prabh apanee agan saagar vikaraalaa ||
lines.translation: Protect me, please protect me, O God; I have come to Your Sanctuary; the ocean of fire is so horrible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ke sukhadaate satigur ham tumare baal gupaalaa ||2||30||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of peace to Nanak; I am Your child, O Lord of the World. ||2||30||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord God has saved me, His slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam siu mero man maaniaa taap muaa bikh khaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind has surrendered to my Beloved; my fever has taken poison and died. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paalaa taaoo kachhoo na biaapai raam naam gun gaai ||
lines.translation: Cold and heat do not touch me at all, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daakee ko chit kachhoo na laagai charan kamal saranaai ||1||
lines.translation: My consciousness is not affected by the witch, Maya; I take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhae kirapaalaa hoe aap sahaai ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has shown His Mercy to me; He Himself is my Help and Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan nit gaavai naanak sahasaa dukh mitaai ||2||31||
lines.translation: Nanak ever sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; his doubts and pains are eliminated. ||2||31||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
I have taken the medicine of the Name of the Lord.
I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been removed. ||1||
The fever has been broken, by the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anad bhaiaa sabh mite visoore ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am in ecstasy, and all of my sorrows have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
All beings and creatures obtain peace,
O Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord God. ||2||32||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
That time, which the mortal does not wish for, eventually comes.
Without the Lord's Command, how can understanding be understood? ||1||
The body is consumed by water, fire and earth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu na baalaa boodhaa bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: But the soul is neither young nor old, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
Servant Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy.
By Guru's Grace, he has shaken off the fear of death. ||2||33||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
Forever and ever, the soul is illumined;
in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it dwells at the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam nit jap man mere ||
lines.translation: Chant the Lord's Name each and every day, O my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetal saa(n)t sadaa sukh paavahi kilavikh jaahi sabhe man tere ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karam ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect good karma,
meets the True Guru, and obtains the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ||2||34||
Thirty-four Shabads in Second House. ||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa har suaamee prabh belee ||
lines.translation: She who has the Lord God as her Friend
